grammar.summary: 本课探讨寻找地外生命，集中运用了形式主语 it、条件句与虚拟语气以及定语从句。课文用 it 作形式主语引出客观判断，用 if 引导条件句推测生命存在的条件，用 that/which 引导定语从句修饰恒星与行星。

points.title: 形式主语 it (Anticipatory it)
points.explanation: 当真正的主语是较长的不定式短语或从句时，用 it 作形式主语置于句首，使句子平衡。本课用 it 引出「发现行星成为可能」「寻找生命将证明困难」等判断。

examples.en: Recent developments in astronomy have made it possible to detect planets in our won Milky Way and in other galaxies.
examples.cn: 天文学方面最新发展使得我们能够在银河系和其他星系发现行星。

examples.en: It is impossible to look for life on another planet using earth-based telescopes.
examples.cn: 使用放置在地球上的望远镜是无法观察到其他行星的生命的。

points.title: 条件句与虚拟语气 (Conditionals & Subjunctive)
points.explanation: 用 if 引导条件句，主句用 would 表示推测或假设结果。本课用 if the star were small, the life-supporting planet would have to... 表示对恒星与行星关系的假设推断。

examples.en: Alternatively, if the star were small, the life-supporting planet would have to have a close orbit round it and also provide the perfect conditions for life forms to develop.
examples.cn: 反之，如果恒星很小，维持生命的行星就要在离恒星很近的轨道上运行，而且要有极好的条件才能使生命得以发展。

examples.en: If we were able to discover lowly forms of life like bacteria on another planet, it would completely change our view of ourselves.
examples.cn: 如果我们能够在另一颗行星上找到诸如细菌的那种低等生命，那么这个发现将彻底改变我们对我们自己的看法。

points.title: 定语从句 (Relative Clauses)
points.explanation: 用 that/which 引导定语从句修饰先行词。本课用 that 修饰 telescope（能发现生命的望远镜），用 which 修饰 life forms，使长句结构紧凑、信息完整。

examples.en: At present, there is no telescope in existence that is capable of detecting the presence of life.
examples.cn: 现在，没有一台现存的望远镜可以发现生命的存在。

examples.en: It is bacteria that have generated the oxygen we breathe on earth.
examples.cn: 正是细菌生产出我们在地球上呼吸的氧气。

exercises.q: Recent developments in astronomy have made ______ possible to detect planets in our won Milky Way and in other galaxies.
Alternatively, if the star ______ small, the life-supporting planet would have to have a close orbit round it.
At present, there is no telescope in existence ______ is capable of detecting the presence of life.
用强调句型填空：______ is bacteria that have generated the oxygen we breathe on earth.（填出句首的形式主语）
